medium: JUST BEFORE MIDNIGHT, THE CANDLELIT ATTIC ECHOED THROUGH THE EMPTY STREET.
A STRANGE SYMBOL APPEARED BESIDE THE CANDLELIT ATTIC WHEN THE MOON ROSE.
THE CANDLELIT ATTIC SEEMED QUIET UNTIL THREE SOFT KNOCKS ANSWERED FROM WITHIN.
NO ONE COULD EXPLAIN WHY THE CANDLELIT ATTIC CAST A SHADOW AGAINST THE WIND.
A BRAVE TRAVELER FOLLOWED THE CANDLELIT ATTIC PAST THE LAST LANTERN.
THE CANDLELIT ATTIC HELD A CLUE THAT THE OLD WITCH HAD LEFT BEHIND.
EVERY CANDLE WENT OUT WHEN SOMEONE MENTIONED THE CANDLELIT ATTIC.
THE CANDLELIT ATTIC BECAME BRIGHTER AS THE HAUNTED HOUSE GREW SILENT.
